outcome: Success rate of obstetric fistula repair
cohort: 328 patients with obstetric fistula at Mekelle Hamlin Fistula Center (MHFC)
finding: Fistula closure was achieved in 89.3% of cases, with higher success rates observed among women with formal education, live births, and other factors such as BMI, antibiotic use, and fistula size.
